unsupported_claims: `Name: ... built from birth as the instrument of a revenge he did not choose and could not refuse` imports child-phase framing and asserts inner necessity not established by the vol06-vol08 source records.

`TRAIT: The thing he will not do... This is the one promise he will not break under maximum pressure` is too absolute and conflicts with the vol08 pressure trajectory, where the ordinary-family vow remains unresolved and later transforms under crisis.
`TRAIT: Cybernetically augmented: prosthetic metal feet earned by allowing a crushing machine to destroy them in childhood...` belongs to `aghnar__child`, not this split-phase peer.

`ALIAS: Kiowotai / Kioka` should not promote unresolved Magon naming into aliases for Aghnar; the identity overlap is explicitly uncertain and there are separate peer identities for nearby Magon/Kiowotai material.
`TRAIT: On Perdita... defeated the Magon Patriarch and fulfilled their prophecy` overstates uncertain Kiowotai/Kioka/Aghnar material and flattens Magon belief into confirmed biography.

`Oda accepted it knowing it was not real` and `blue-rose illusion she accepted knowing` are not supported by the Aghnar source records in the bundle; they appear to come from relationship/link-matrix orientation and should not be imported as base biography.
